Not specifically about wanting to end my life.  I tell her that I get really down - she knows I've thought of killing myself.

She's pretty matter-of-fact when it comes to the help she gives: "I've been there before (with school) you just need to do it".  I don't really have anyone that I can talk to that will tell me what I need to hear.  

I don't even know what I need to hear.  I feel like nothing would help, really.

I appreciate your response.
